ContainerTables.description:
How many of a room's chests and barrels a dungeon places (RLM-365): for each kind, the chance of each count.
A room's candidates are its template's single chests and its barrels (trapped chests and double chests always
stay); the builder keeps that many of them, at most as many as the room holds, and the rest become the block
around them. A kind without a table keeps all of its candidates.

anyOf.description: The chance in percent of each count (0 to 64), adding up to 100, e.g. {1: 75, 2: 20, 3: 5}.

barrels.description: How many of its barrels stay.
barrels.title: Barrels

chests.description: How many of its single chests stay.

RoomSource.description: Where an imported room came from, written by ``rf rooms import``.

data_version.description: The data version the source was saved with (for a file that states none, the import rules' data_version); the template keeps it, and the game upgrades the room from it when it loads.
data_version.title: Data Version

ours.description: True for a room we built ourselves (exported from a dev world, say). Every other imported room is third-party: it lives in third_party/<source>/ with the source's LICENSE and NOTICE.
ours.title: Ours

description: How dungeons use a room. The template next to it holds the blocks.

containers.description: How many of its chests and barrels a dungeon places, where the dungeon type's table for its role does not fit it (RLM-365). A kind it leaves out follows the dungeon type.

entry.description: The side of the template (as saved, before any turn) whose one connector is the room's way in: a lock's mechanism side. The planner attaches the room to the room before it only through that connector, and no loop leads into the room from another side (RLM-362). Unset: any connector.
entry.title: Entry

explosion_breaks.description: Blocks an explosion inside this room may break in a dungeon instance, where explosions otherwise break nothing: what a trap's TNT is meant to blow open (RLM-257). Every other block of the room stays.

items.description: Namespaced id, e.g. minecraft:stone. Validated against the ID universe.

explosion_breaks.title: Explosion Breaks

max_per_layout.description: The most times one dungeon layout holds this room; no limit when unset (RLM-256).
max_per_layout.title: Max Per Layout

near_start.description: True: the planner places this room only next to the entrance or the first room of the main path, at the dungeon's start (RLM-256).
near_start.title: Near Start

pools.description: The room pools the room joins (e.g. realmforge:stone_vault): a dungeon type is built from the rooms of one pool. Empty for a room that is not used yet, such as a fresh import.

items.description: Namespaced id, e.g. minecraft:stone. Validated against the ID universe.

pools.title: Pools

tags.description: Slot types and other labels: one role (entrance, hallway, combat, stairs, treasure, boss), which a room in a pool must have, the shape (dead_end, straight, curved, t_junction, crossing), vertical, ...
tags.title: Tags

weight.description: Weight in its pools (vanilla allows 1 to 150).
weight.title: Weight
